# Ankhimate — Windows + PixiJS experimental alpha

> The editor authors projects; the TypeScript core evaluates native exports and
> the PixiJS adapter renders only the documented native v2 WebGL2 subset.

## Start here
- [Getting Started](docs/alpha/GETTING_STARTED.md)
- [PixiJS public APIs and ownership](docs/alpha/PIXIJS_INTEGRATION.md)
- [Compatibility and exclusions](docs/alpha/RUNTIME_COMPATIBILITY.md)
- [Native runtime v2](docs/alpha/FORMAT_V2.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/alpha/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
- [AI integration context](docs/alpha/AI_INTEGRATION_CONTEXT.md)
- [Licenses](docs/ALPHA-LICENSES.md)

## Rules for integrations
Use real public APIs; do not invent constraint, blend, linked-mesh or audio support.
Core v1 reading does not mean the PixiJS adapter accepts v1. Do not invert export
coordinates, change normalized curves or reinterpret weighted FFD offsets.
Events at t=0 are ignored on startup and every loop. Interrupted crossfades may
jump. Explicitly clean up instances before their asset. Jade Sentinel is the only
official sample. No AI model is bundled or required.
